tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (da)༄༅/ /grub chen khyung po'i mgur brgyad dang bka' rgya ma bzhi bcas bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/grub thob chen po rā hu la'i gdams pa/bla ma sha
(da)༄༅/ /grub chen khyung po'i mgur brgyad dang bka' rgya ma bzhi bcas bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/grub thob chen po rā hu la'i gdams pa/bla ma sha

tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// grub chen khyung po'i mgur brgyad dang bka' rgya ma bzhi bcas bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ grub thob chen po rā hu la'i gdams pa/ bla ma shangs pas mgur du bzhengs pa 'di yin te/ gzung 'dzin rnam rtog tho co che// thim pa rnam gsum gdams ngag bdog /gzung 'dzin g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /gzung 'dzin ci ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// lha chen dpe dkar tho co che// thi gu mtho gsum gdams ngag bdog /lha chen g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /lha chen ci ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// klu bdud nag po tho co che// thod pa kha sbyor gdams ngag bdog /klu bdud g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /klu bdud ci ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// mtshan mo'i 'byung po tho co che// bdud rtsi thig le'i gdams ngag bdog /'byung po'i g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /'byung po ci ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// byad stems nag po tho co che/ rdo leb nag po'i gdams pa bdog /byad stems g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /byad stems ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// 'chi bdag nag po tho co che// keng rus ta ra'i gdams pa bdog /'chi bdag g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /'chi bdag ci ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// gza' bdud nag po tho co che// rus sbal tsakra'i gdams pa bdog /gza' bdud g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /khyab 'jug ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// ngag la byin gyis ma brlabs pas// bzlas pa rnams la nus ma byung*// ā li kā li'i gdams pa bdog /mi 'grub snyam pa'i dogs pa med// ces mgur brgyad po 'di khyung pos tshogs gral du gsungs pa'o// de la dang po thim pa rnam gsum gyi gdams ngag nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rigs drug gi sems can 'di rnams thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba 'di rnams gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi rtogs pas lan pas des phyi gzung ba'i yul la zhen pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur thim par bsgom/

de rnams su 'dzin pa'i sems kyi rnam par rtog pa de yang snang la rang bzhin med par thim par bsgom/ de ltar sgom byed kyi shes pa de yang chos kyi dbyings su thim par bsgom pa ni/ mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so// rjes thob snang ba zhen med du sems can gyi don grub tshad du bya'o// man ngag 'di nyams su len nus na/ sangs rgya ba la the tshom med/ thim pa rnam gsum ཿ mgur gnyis pa'i don ni/ rang nyid la dpe dkar ram/ rgyal po la sogs pa'i gdug rtsub che ba byung na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ bal skud sum sgril mtho gsum pa cig gsang ba rdo rje'i dkyil du se chings byas la/ skud pa'i sne gnyis ske rags la brtod de/ rdo rje'i kha gyen du bstan na phyi nas gdon thams cad thub bo// de lta bu'i srung skud de la yi dam gyi lha mang du bstims la/ sngags mang du btab/ rang lus me 'bar bar bsam mo// dpe dkar srung ba ཿ mgur gsum pa'i don ni/ rang la klu bdud la sogs pa'i gnod pa byed pa'am/ 'dre'am/ rbad dam/ dam can la sogs pas gnod na/ rang nyid thod pa dum bu gcig pa bre dkar tsam gnyis sbyar ba'i nang du kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse gsum pa rwa dbus la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa cig tu bsams la gnyid log go /thod pa kha sbyor 'di ma chag par bsgom nus na/ rbod gtong byad stems dam can sogs gnod byed thams cad kyis gnod par mi nus so// gsum pa ཿ mgur bzhi pa'i don ni/ mtshan mo'i 'byung po bsrung bar 'dod na/ nub mo rang dur khrod la sogs pa bag tsha ba'am/ sa gnyan par 'gro na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rang gi dri chen ril ma tsam gcig dang*/ dri chu dang po lug rmig tsam lag mthil g.yas par g.yon pa'i srin lag gis mnye ste/ srin lag gis blangs la rang gi dpral bar bzhag nas/ mthe'u chung ngos nas bskor ba'i thig le byas nas/

rang nyid yi dam du bsgoms te 'gro ba'i thog mtha' gnyis kyi tshe bzlas na/ mtshan mo'i 'byung po'i gdon thams cad thub par 'gyur ro// de ni srung ba che gsung ngo*// ཿ mgur lnga pa'i don ni/ byad stems nag po zhes bya ba ban bon gyi rbod kha bsrung na/ chu mig lkug pa kha byang bstan cig tu rdo leb nag po gcig bcug la bzhag de mthu byed pa byung ba dang*/ rdo leb la rang gi grib ma dang kha rlangs ma shor bar byas te/ dar ram ras kyi kha la blangs te me la bsros nas/ la mtshal gyi myu gus (khkhahūm̐)bris la/ yang sngar gyi chu mig tu sa la sbyar la gzhug go /de ltar byas na ngan sngags sam/ lha sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa kho rang la ldog par the tshom med do// 'di gang thong thong la spel na bstan pa la gnod pas mi spel lo// rdo leb nag po'i gdams pa ཿ mgur drug pa'i don ni/ rang la phyi nang la sogs pa'i 'chi ltas byung na/ ltas de srung ba'i thabs ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rang gi lus po phyi sha dang pags pa/ nang gi klad pa dang rtsa rgyus thams cad lus kyi gos phud pa bzhin du dor te/ rang gi lus keng rus su dkar krong nge bsgom na/ 'chi bdag gi bdud 'joms so// de yang*/ kang ka la'i rnam pa'am// yang na thod pa nyid kyang rung*// gsar par gso ba ma yin te// 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i mchog yin no// zhes a bhi dha na las gsungs so// keng rus ta ra'i 'chi bslu ཿ mgur bdun pa'i don ni/ ser ba bsrung ba ste/ rdzas la rus sbal gyi gzugs khong stong cig byas la so btang*/ de'i khog par sngags 'di bris la gzhug go /oṃ ru ru ki li ki li pra ma ni/ khu ru pa ta dur ni swā hā/ 'byung po kha tham zhes pa 'di nyer gcig bris pa de la/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas rab gnas byas pa/ yi ge'i dbu rus sbal gyi mgrin par bstan la gzhug go /de nas sngags 'di sbal pa'i rgyab tu gdab bo// oṃ na ra sim/

thi ra dha ra/ bha saṃ yai/ ghu tri hā/ dzwa ki ni/ dzwa ki ni/ tsa ra ka ra bi shud rbud/ bhandha bhandha/ dha dhi bhandha/ lce re bhandha/ na ra siṃ/ ka na tsa ko ri/ si ti mi ri/ hi ra bho ri/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa 'di sbal pa'i rgyab tu gdab bo// sngags 'di bcu bcus ser ba zhag re thub bo// brgya bzlas na zhag bcu/ sum brgyas zla ba gcig drug brgyas zla ba gnyis/ dgu brgyas zla ba gsum thub bo// yang sngags bcus chang tshod re thub bo// zhing yang de dang 'dra/ de bzhin grangs gong dang 'dra'o// sbal pa nam mkha' mthong ba'i sar bzhag na/ rang gzhi la mi sdod kyang ser ba thub bo// gdong zlog byed na/ sbal pa lag tu bzung ste/ sngags bzlas pas thogs pa med do// sbal pa'i kha ser rkang 'jug pa'i sar bstan no// phyogs gang na 'ong ba des 'gre'o// rgya che chung dmigs pa gtso che'o// dus ji tsam du bsrung ba dpyad la bya'o// gang dmigs pa thub bo// dus tshod grangs tshad la sogs zhal las shes so// gzo ba/ bri ba/ rab gnas gsum rgyal la bya'o// bsnyen rgyab yod na mchog med na sngags rings sngon la mang du bzla'o// ཿ mgur brgyad pa'i don ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ tho rangs dge sbyor gang byed pa'i sngon du/ rang yi dam lhar gsal ba'i lce thog tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po bsam/ de la ā li kā lis bskor bar bsam te/ ā li kā li oṃ dang swā hā'i bar du bcug la lan gsum gsum brjod par bya'o// ngag gi nus pa mthar thon te/ bzlas brjod nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// 'di slob dpon rnams rtsis che thugs dam du mdzad do// ngag la byin gyis brlab pa'o// ཿ mgur brgyad kyi gdams pa rdzogs so/ ༈ /gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel lo// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan don mi 'grub mi srid pa'i rten 'brel ni/

sems bskyed pa sngon du song bas rang yi dam gyi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs dang*/ ye shes kyi chos skyong dang bcas pa thams cad bla ma de la bstim mo// de nas snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che// bdag gi skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu// gzhan don 'ba' zhig 'grub par mdzad du gsol// ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bsgoms pa'i rkyen gyis/ spyi bo'i bla ma de rang la thim pa dang*/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po shin tu che bar bsgoms nas/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po dungs dungs pa bsgoms la smon lam gdab par bya ste/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu/ gzhan don 'ba' zhig 'grub par gyur cig bdag gi lus kyis sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byed par gyur cig ngag gis sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byed par gyur cig yid kyis sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byed par gyur cig lus ngag yid gsum gyis 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di stong par ma gyur gyi bar du/ sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byed par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod do// yang padma drwa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin du/ bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi// mgon skyabs re gnas gyur nas kyang*// sems can kun gyi re 'dod kun// tshul bzhin du ni skongs gyur cig /ces lan gsum mam lnga brjod par bya'o// 'di la yon tan dpag tu med pa yod do// 'di dang phyi mar gzhan don mi 'byung mi srid do gsung ngo*// gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel dge'o// ༈ /rig 'dzin khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas bka' rgya ma bzhugs so// sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed phrag bdun nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la=

lan gcig phyir 'ong ba= rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la= 'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la= brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la= mthu stobs kyi bdag po rnams la= sems can gyi don du sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de ring rgyu sbyor yon gi bdag po rnams dang bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i dbang gis bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten khyad par can

khang pa lta bu la/ gnas khang nyid du/ sogs dang*/ gzhan yang*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo nyid la/ zhes sogs ji ltar rigs par kha bsgyur bya'o/ 'di rnams la 'byon pa dang*/ rab tu gnas par mdzad du gsol/ ces lan gsum dang*/ rten 'brel snying po brjod/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan pa/ bde ba chen po bde ba bla na med pa/ byang chub chen po chos kyi sku chos thams cad mi gnas pa'i ngo bor rab tu gnas par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum brjod la slar yang rten 'brel snying po brjod/ ji srid me dang chu dang ni// rlung gi bskal pas 'jigs pa dang*// ji ltar nam mkha' gnas kyi bar// ston pa khyod ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /ces sogs shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs brjod par bya'o// sarba dā su pra maṅga laṃ bha wa tu/ ༈ /rab gnas bka' rgya ma bzhugs// na mo gu ru badzra tā rā yai/ rab gnas bka' rgya ma'i zhal gdams 'di la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gang la rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten la dar ser la sogs pas bkab ste bzhag de yang rang nyid skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ldan pas/ rje btsun sgrol mar bsgom zhing mdun du 'khar gzhong la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar 'bras sam/ nas dkar mo bzang pos bkang la/ ye dharmā brgya'am stong la sogs pa ci rigs bzlas pas/ me tog de rnams rje btsun sgrol ma'i lha tshogs dpag tu med par bsam zhing*/ byin gyis brlabs te sta gon du gnas par bya'o// dngos gzhi nam phyed du song ba dang rten gyi drung du phyin la/ rten gyi khebs bsal te/ rten de nyid rje btsun ma sgrol mar skad cig gis bskyed la/ sngar gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i me sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo sogs bton/

tog gtor bas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rten la sib sib thim pas/ de rje btsun ma'i sku shin tu gsal zhing ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku chung ba yan lag dod pas dkrigs thams la bsdams par bsam zhing*/ me tog gtor/ rjes la bkra smon lam dang bkra shis bka' rgya ma bya'o gsung*/ shis la sogs pa bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o// rab gnas bka' rgya ma shin tu zab pas gsang bar bya'o// ཿ nam phyed rig pa dus gnad yin/ ༈ /bla ma shangs pa'i maṇḍal bka' rgya ma bzhugs so// bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i maṇḍal mchog /dbus kyi ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran bcas// gsal byed nyi ma zla bas bskor zhing mdzes// phyi rol lcags ri bar ni rol mtshos brgyan// rin chen dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen gter brgyad dang*// ma rmos lo tog yan lag brgyad ldan chu// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin bsam mi khyab// dga' dang spro ba skyed pa'i maṇḍal 'di// don gnyis sgrub par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas// brtson pa'i stobs kyis bla ma yi dam dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi// sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor pas// mnyes byed maṇḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun byang nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /nai gu ma'i smon lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ arya pra ṇi dhā na rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa smon lam gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// thugs rje phrin las phun sum tshogs pa yis// bdag gi smon lam 'di dag thams cad kun// ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub par shog /'di nas bzung ste rnam pa thams cad du// mos gus tshad med bla ma mnyes byed cing*// rnam dag lus ngag longs spyod mkha' mnyam mchod// skad cig mi 'bral phrin las rgyas byed shog

/tshe rabs kun tu nyan bshad sgom grub tshe// log pa'i slob dpon de bzhin bla mar ngan// grogs ngan sbyin bdag ngan pa mi phrad cing*// bla ma mchog bsten byang chub der thob shog /skye ba kun tu rigs bzang nad med cing*// dbyangs snyan gzugs mdzes gzi brjid stobs ldan nas// tshe ring 'khor dang longs spyod chos rnams kun// lhun gyis grub cing kun gyis bkur bar shog /gang du skyes pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du// sems can rnams kyis mthong thos dran reg tshe// mdzes shing yid 'ong lta bas mi ngoms shing*// mi mthun phyogs bral kun dang mthun par shog /bdag ni mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi// mgon skyabs re gnas dpung gnyen gyur nas kyang*// gang la gang 'dod re ba thams cad kun// tshul bzhin bdag gis ma lus skong bar shog /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs rnams dang*// lus ngag yid gsum smon lam gcig tu spyad// dus 'di nas bzung skad cig mi 'bral zhing*// dag snang bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /gang skyes yid bzhin nor bur bdag gyur te// dgos 'dod thams cad yid la bsams ma thag /phun sum tshogs pa dpag med char babs nas// sems can thams cad bde la 'god par shog /bdag ni gnas pa'i sa phyogs thams cad du// 'gro kun nad gdon 'thab rtsod dbul phongs bral// tshe ring nad med chos dang longs spyod ldan// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba thams cad du// longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes nas// sbyin pa rnam bzhi phyogs bcur gtong byed cing*// pha rol phyin bcur 'gro kun smin grol shog /'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus thams cad la// chags thogs med pa'i shes rab phun tshogs nas// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun// skad cig tsam gyis thams cad mngon gyur shog /bdag ni bslab gsum dri med legs brgyan zhing*// rtsod bral lhar bcas 'jig rten mchod cing bstod// tshul khrims mchog la 'gro ba kun bkod cing*// legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rab rdzogs shog

/ri khrod dgon par chog shes zas gos ldan// phyi nang bar chad skad cig mi 'byung bar// nyams rtog mthar phyin phrin las tshad med kyis// 'gro rnams ma lus smin cing grol byed shog /lha 'dre stobs ldan dregs can ma lus kun// bsnyen sgrub rbad bskul skad cig mi dgos par// srog snying dbul zhing bran bzhin nyan pa dang*// mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa bsrung bar shog /bdag gis byams dang snying rje mngon gyur te// khams gsum sems can ma lus thams cad kun// gcig la gcig 'tshe'i gnod pa rab zhi nas// bu gcig ma bzhin brtse bar gnas par shog /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa'i tshe// gnad gcod mi 'byung chos sku mngon gyur nas// gzugs sku rang shar gzhan don lhun grub cing*// sku gdung ring bsrel 'gro ba 'dren par shog /rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus thams cad du// sangs rgyas bskal pa'i rdul snyed rgya mtsho las// kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' mnyam pa yis// bskal pa rgya mtshor bdag gis mchod byed shog /zhing khams rnam dag rgya mtsho mngon gyur te// spyod pa rnam dag shes rab tshad med kyis// chos rnams rgya mtsho thams cad rab mthong nas// ye shes rgya mtsho ma lus rtogs par shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung dbyangs mngon gyur nas// nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tshangs pa'i dbyangs sgrogs shing*// 'gro rnams skad du bdag gis chos bstan nas// sems can ma lus sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /kun bzang sgyu ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin du// mtha' bral sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin mngon gyur nas// sangs rgyas sku dang zhing khams ma lus kun// rdul gcig steng du skad cig 'grub par shog /sems can khams dang rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' dang*// nam mkha'i mtha' dang chos dbyings tshad med ltar// bdag gi smon lam ting 'dzin phrin las rnams// gting mtha' dpag med tshad bzung med par shog

/'khor los sgyur rgyal dpag med bdag sprul nas// 'gro kun re skong chos kyi rgyal srid skyong*// mkha' mnyam zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur nas// sems can ma lus bde la 'god par shog /ma 'ongs dus su nad mtshon bskal pa yis// sems can sdug bsngal nyam thag gyur pa'i tshe// bdag ni sman mchog rgyal por gyur nas kyang*// skad cig nyid la sdug bsngal zhi byed shog /mu ge'i bskal pas bkres skom gyur pa'i tshe// bza' btung dar zab gser dngul longs spyod rnams// phun sum tshogs pa mkha' mnyam sprin btibs nas// phyogs bcur 'dod yon lnga yi char 'bebs shog /byang chub sems kyi spyod pa rlabs chen gyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur tshe// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can ma lus kun// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston shog /log pa'i lam zhugs stobs ldan dregs pa can// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal bas ma thul ba'i// 'gro kun ma lus bdag gis rab btul nas// skad cig nyid la sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /ji srid 'khor bar sems can gnas kyi bar// de srid phrin las rtsol med rang shar gyis// sems can ma lus smin cing grol byed pa'i// 'gro don lhun grub rgyun chad med par shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// so so skye bo byang chub sems dpa'i tshe// bskal pa grangs med sems bskyed smon lam btab// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin mngon par sangs rgyas nas// phun sum tshogs mnga' yon tan rgya mtsho yi// sems can dpag med smin cing grol mdzad pa'i// smon lam 'phrin las gcig tu bsdoms pa bas// bdag gi smon lam phrin las rgya cher shog /gzhan don lhun grub dpag med 'byung 'gyur ba'i// bdag gi smon lam 'di dag thams cad kun// byang chub mchog mos dad pa rab bskyed de// gang gis 'debs pa de la yongs rdzogs shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum 'khor 'das thams cad kyi// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa kun// rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// bdag gzhan phyogs rnams kun tu khyab par shog

/'phags pa smon lam gyi rgyal po rdzogs so// ཿ bkra shis bka' rgya ma bzhugs so// oṃ/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin// byin rlabs chu bos skal ldan tshim mdzad cing*// rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i// chos rje bla ma rnams kyis bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du// dam tshig can la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis shog /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brang zhing*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs// sna tshogs phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin// yid la byar med bde gsal nam mkha'i ngang*// bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams// bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la bsten cing mchod pa dang*// skur pa 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa// thams cad byang chub lam la sbyor mdzad pa'i// mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi// bkra shis sgo mang ji snyed yod pa kun// phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du// skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu bkra shis shog /bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab// tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun grub pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
